title: Hath0rFactoryManifest
description: Schema definition for Hath0r declarative automation factories and orchestrated micro-bots.

factory_id.description: Unique identifier for the factory, lowercase hyphen-separated.

name.description: Human-readable display name for the factory.

version.description: SemVer version of the factory specification.

description.description: Detailed description of the factory purpose and lifecycle responsibilities.

author.description: Author or organization responsible for the factory.

category.description: Categorization tag for filtering and reporting.

bots.description: List of micro-bots participating in the factory.

id.description: Identifier for the bot, referenced in workflow steps.

capabilities.description: Named capabilities or supported actions for this bot.

workflows.description: List of declarative workflows executed by the factory.

id.description: Unique identifier for this workflow within the factory.

schedule.description: Optional cron schedule expression (5 fields: minute hour day-of-month month day-of-week).

steps.description: Sequential steps executed within the workflow.

bot.description: Referenced bot ID from the bots list.

action.description: Action or capability invoked on the bot.

args.description: Optional key-value arguments for the action.

on_failure.description: Failure policy when the step errors: continue, abort (default), or retry.

retry_count.description: Maximum number of retry attempts when on_failure is set to retry.
